ticketType.title: Ticket type
ticketType.summary: What a place at an event costs for one kind of participant
ticketType.description: A ticket type of one event: player, crew, NPC or other, with its listed price, an optional sale window and an optional number of places. A hidden ticket type is offered only to someone with a code that unlocks it. Larpinq records the listed price on a registration; the amount due and the payment are handled by shillinq.

event.title: Event
event.description: The event this ticket type is for

name.title: Name
name.description: The name players see, such as Player early bird

amount.title: Listed price
amount.description: The price in cents. A later change applies to new choices only.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency of the price, such as EUR

saleFrom.title: On sale from
saleFrom.description: From this moment the ticket type is offered. Empty means from now.

saleUntil.title: On sale until
saleUntil.description: After this moment the ticket type is no longer offered, as for an early bird price

placeLimit.title: Places
placeLimit.description: How many accepted registrations this ticket type takes. Empty means no limit of its own.

hidden.title: Only with a code
hidden.description: Offered only to someone who enters a code that unlocks it

order.title: Order
order.description: Where the ticket type is listed among the others

registrationOption.title: Registration option
registrationOption.summary: An extra a player can choose with their registration, such as a meal plan
registrationOption.description: An extra of one event with its listed price, such as full catering, vegan. An option with a number of places is refused once it is full.

event.title: Event
event.description: The event this option is for

name.title: Name
name.description: The name players see, such as Full catering, vegan

category.title: Category
category.description: Meal for catering choices, other for anything else

amount.title: Listed price
amount.description: The price in cents. A later change applies to new choices only.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency of the price, such as EUR

placeLimit.title: Places
placeLimit.description: How many accepted registrations can choose this option. Empty means no limit.

accessCode.title: Access code
accessCode.summary: A code that unlocks hidden ticket types of an event
accessCode.description: A code a game master hands out, such as to crew friends. Entered on a registration, it unlocks the hidden ticket types it names, inside its valid window and up to its number of uses. Only game masters see codes.

event.title: Event
event.description: The event this code is for

code.title: Code
code.description: What a player types, such as LANTERN. Upper and lower case count the same.

unlocks.title: Unlocks
unlocks.description: The hidden ticket types this code makes available

validFrom.title: Valid from
validFrom.description: From this moment the code works. Empty means from now.

validUntil.title: Valid until
validUntil.description: After this moment the code no longer works

maxUses.title: Uses
maxUses.description: How many registrations can use the code. Empty means no limit.

ticketType.title: Ticket type
ticketType.description: The ticket type the player chose

options.title: Options
options.description: The extras the player chose, such as a meal plan

code.title: Code
code.description: The code the player entered to unlock a hidden ticket type

accessCode.title: Code used
accessCode.description: The code that matched, set by larpinq

lines.title: Price lines
lines.description: The listed price of each choice when it was made, set by larpinq. Larpinq adds nothing up; the amount due comes from shillinq.

ref.title: Chosen
ref.description: The ticket type or option chosen

name.title: Name
name.description: The name when it was chosen

amount.title: Listed price
amount.description: The listed price in cents when it was chosen

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency of the price, such as EUR
